about_short_description.short_description: Pala De 7 is a user-friendly platform that offers the Padel community field registration and simple booking using AI technology.

product.name: Pala De 7 Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app for the padel community to book courts, create games, join tournaments, and connect with players using AI technology.

product.name: Court Booking System
product.description: An online system to reserve padel courts easily at preferred times and locations.

product.name: Online Split Payment Feature
product.description: A payment feature that allows players to share and settle court fees conveniently online.

product.name: Game Creation and Scheduling
product.description: A tool to set up and schedule padel games with friends or other players through the app.

product.name: Skill-Level Based Matchmaking
product.description: A matchmaking system that pairs players with opponents of similar skill levels.

product.name: Padel Tournaments Management
product.description: A platform to organize, join, and compete in padel tournaments through the app.
